title: G11: Explorer stage inside lessons (M)
description:
The Compilation Explorer can be a stage in a lesson, with scene control over the view.
Acceptance:
- Given a lesson scene with an explorer stage, it shows source, RV32 and bytes.
- A scene can spotlight a line and ask a question about it.
- Works offline of the lesson player chrome limits (no extra panels).
right_now_summary: The lesson explorer stage will show source, RV32, bytes, and line-based questions offline.
